issues.detail: The Hebrew name רְזוֹן (Rezon) is rendered as 利遙, which is not a standard transliteration; the expected Chinese rendering would be 利遜 or similar. This could cause a reader to identify the wrong person.
The Hebrew name הֲדַדְעֶזֶר (Hadadezer) is rendered as 大德謝爾, which is an inaccurate transliteration; the standard rendering is 哈大底謝. This swaps the name for a different-sounding one.
